# TajAttire

> TajAttire is a wholesale manufacturer of women's kurtis, gowns and contemporary tops, based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, established in 2004. It sells to retailers, boutiques and wholesalers across India (B2B only).

## Key facts
- Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- Established: 2004
- Products: kurtis (cotton, rayon, printed, embroidered), gowns (floor-length, anarkali), contemporary tops
- Catalogue size: 500+ designs
- Minimum order: 100 pieces per style (catalogue); 200 pieces per design (custom / private label)
- Wholesale prices: from ₹180 per piece for kurtis; gowns and tops vary with fabric and design
- Lead time: 7–15 days for catalogue orders; 20–30 days for custom orders
- Payment: 50% advance on confirmation, 50% before dispatch (NEFT / RTGS / IMPS / UPI)
- Shipping: across India via Delhivery, Bluedart and DTDC
- Samples: available at a nominal charge, adjusted against the first bulk order
- Private label: woven labels, hang tags, printed polybags, branded cartons
- Factory visits: welcome, by appointment
- GSTIN: 08EZDPA6047K1Z9

## Contact
